description: Anything to deal with later, sent from the share sheet in Safari, Mail or any other app: choose Routine Run, then Inbox. Go through it when you have a minute; it never closes, and it waits when it is empty.
name: Inbox

steps.description: Anywhere there is a Share button: press it, choose Routine Run, then Inbox. It arrives as a step, after whatever is waiting. Press Next when you have tried it.
steps.title: Send the first one here
